sentence: This project builds a course that uses virtual reality experiences of clinics to help identify and evaluate real world healthcare problems.
This project creates a cis-regulatory map of the human genome to connect disease variants to functions and phenotypes.
This project studies how cortical mechanisms support the use of vocalizations to make social decisions in families of gerbils.
This project uses health information technology to find patients who have social risk factors and to assess them, aiming to improve outcomes of Veterans.
This project curates, tracks and distributes animal models of glioblastoma and makes organoids from them for experimental studies.
This project studies how microtubules behave by combining biochemical reconstitution, live-cell imaging and computational modeling.
This project compares neural progenitor cells in humans, monkeys and mice to find human-specific cells and how they shape the central nervous system.
This project tries to restore immune cues from dendritic cells so that T cells can attack glioblastoma, using gene and vesicle-based delivery.
This project tries to find out how an epigenetic mark controls the expression of genes for cilium morphogenesis and mitochondria in mammalian skin development.
This project studies how telomere-associated genes and immune checkpoint genes are regulated in cancer, using computational and experimental methods.
This project uses a systems biology approach to understand the effectiveness and safety of drugs given for common acute conditions.
This project uses imaging datasets and deep learning to find neural biotypes behind posttraumatic stress, major depressive and anxiety disorders.
This project studies how receptor agonist drugs, alone and combined with exercise, protect the brain and heart in mouse models of Alzheimer’s disease.
This project uses machine learning with smartphone sensors and a wrist-worn band to predict emotional distress and risk of depression in adolescents.
This project studies how oncogenic human viruses control transcription and replication in hypoxia during long-term viral infection.
This project runs a clinical trial of a nanotechnology-based patch that delivers cisplatin to treat carcinoma in situ of the oral cavity.
This project develops noninvasive liquid biopsy methods using circulating cell-free DNA and RNA to detect, classify and monitor peripheral T-cell lymphomas.
This project builds a spectroscopy and microscopy platform to monitor many interacting species in biological systems using multiplex optical imaging.
This project builds an automated system that uses deep learning to find and analyze rare cancer cells in the blood from large microscope images.
This project engineers a mitochondrial recombination enzyme into a programmable gene-editor that can engineer genome variants and tag proteins.
